text_block_list.name: Shrine-carrying Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Shrine, coming through! Everyone join us in
the chant to give us
strength!

text_block_list.name: Shrine-carrying Umamusume
text_block_list.text: And a one, two, hup! And a one, two, hup!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I am moved! This year's shrine procession is
wonderfully impactful as
always!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The audience numbers have already
broken records, so I hear. Let us
also gear
up to give our own show-stopping
performances!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Y-yes, ma'am! Not long left now... 'til the
show... The big show!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yukino, you okay? We still have some
time, so why don't we relax a
little and
wander around over there?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, um...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...No! I wanna go over the choreography
one last time with Curren! I'm
fine, I
promise!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh... okay. Do your thing.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
All right! The ending is looking good! ♪
You really nailed getting it
cute, Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Curren! Thank you so much! We're so close
to the performance, but
you're still help'n
me!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat it! I want us all to look super
cute out there!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Curren! There you are! The costume
fitter was looking for you.
Said they want
to get started soon.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah! It's that time already? Thank you, City.
Well, Yukino, I'll see you
later!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the training camp, you've been
doing a lot of practice with
Curren, haven't
you?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wha? Th-that's because... we're in the
same class... maybe?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Um, City... Are you... m-mad at me?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: No, not really.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...You know, you could've come to me at
least once. I get that Curren
has more to
teach you, but—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I-it's not that!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wanna be like you... No, I mean, I wanted
to make sure I wouldn't
embarrass you!
That's why...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yukino...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I mean... the word's aren't com'n out right.
In any case, I'm gonna give
it my all!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
With my head held high and pride in my
heart, I'll dance my heart
out!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(City is so beautiful. So, so beautiful. I've
always wanted t'be just like
her.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(And this time, I managed to look her in
the eyes and talk to her
without runn'n
away! Right now, I'm shar'n the same stage
as her!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(I want to stand tall like this forever! I
wanna be glitzy and glam'rous
too!)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(Yukino—ah, can't get distracted. If I'm
not careful, all my attention
will go on
you.)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(You look beautiful—tonight, especially...
But I won't be outshone!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
(Look at those two go. The mood between
them is so intense, the
audience can't
keep their eyes off them.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
(Well, that won't do at all. ♪ Look over
here, everybody. Remember
who you all
came to see?)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Wow, look at City and Curren... even
Yukino. They all look so
dignified. So
beautiful... They're simply awe-inspiring.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. You know, when I saw the older
students run in the Kikuka Sho,
I began to
wonder if I could really do the same...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
But now I'm determined. I'm gonna give it
my best too.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, the target's really not here! They're
inside the sacred
mountain! They were
really serious about doing it the traditional

way?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
President Rudolf and Vice President Brian
look so powerful... It's
kinda scary actually.
But still... I can't wait to see how this turns
out!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: (Hehe. Brian's idea is an instant success.)

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Understood! So you're nominating Curren
Chan, Gold City, and
Yukino Bijin to
perform the ceremonial dance, correct?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Each one will bring a unique color and
charm to the performance.
I believe they
are all capable of excelling in this
endeavor.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Approved! And as for the archery show!
The URA has sent an official
notice that
they'd like you to participate. Will you
accept their
request?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If they ask it of me, I shall oblige. As for
the other participant, may I
make a very
strong recommendation?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Indubitably! Who is it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian. My indispensable comrade.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Brian, do you remember the day I made
you vice president?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Naturally, I've never forgotten.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You out of your mind? You want me to be
vice president of the
student council? Ha,
you've got to be joking.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Though I am currently learning to jest, I am
nowhere near skilled
enough to unveil my
jokes. This is an earnest request. Brian, I
want to
appoint you as vice president.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Hold on. You were running the student
council on your own until last
year.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
And then the one who went up against you
for president—who was it,
Air Groove?
She's your vice president now, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You've got twice the workforce now. Isn't
that enough?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, it is not, Brian. Now that I
have my right hand, my
ambition has
grown. I want to reach toward an ideal
world, and for
that, I'd like you to join me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume of pure instinct. A soul
that burns passionately. It can
only be you,
Brian.

text_block_list.name: Presenter Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
The bonfire has been lit. The archery show
hereby begins!

text_block_list.name: Presenter Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ready, set... go!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: GRRRAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
(Heh... Haha! There it is! It's enough to
give me goosebumps! Brian,
your raging
fangs... your ferocious instincts... they're as
dazzling as
always!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: (And the way you look doing archery...)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Whoa, so cool... I'm trembling!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
(Your unveiled instincts, your
vigor—they're enough to stir any

Umamusume's spirits!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And it seems like I'm no exception!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Bow before me, "Beast"! HAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Aw, the Fleetfoot Festival went so quickly.
This year was even more
lively than usual, I
wish it would go on longer...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. City's group dance and the
presidents' archery really lit a fire in
me.
I'll look back on this fondly.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Tonight's noble Fleetfoot Festival ended
without incident.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
May every Umamusume stay sound of
health, and may they find glory
in their
future.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed. Tonight's Fleetfoot festival
was simply... superb.
